#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a team meeting ICS event: next Wednesday at 3 PM local, 1 hour duration."""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

OUTPUT_FILE = "team_meeting.ics"


def next_wednesday(today):
    """Return the next Wednesday strictly after the given date."""
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == weekday 2
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


now_local = datetime.now().astimezone()
wed_date = next_wednesday(now_local.date())

start_local = datetime(
    wed_date.year, wed_date.month, wed_date.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=now_local.tzinfo
)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)
start_utc = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
end_utc = end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Workspace Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_utc)}",
    f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_utc)}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

ics_text = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_text)

# Validate: re-read and check structure
with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()
assert content == ics_text, "File content mismatch"
assert content.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") and content.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR")
assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in content and "END:VEVENT" in content
assert "SUMMARY:Team Meeting" in content
assert "DTSTART:" in content and "DTEND:" in content and "UID:" in content

print("Current local date/time :", now_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z (%z)"))
print("Local timezone          :", now_local.tzname())
print("Next Wednesday          :", wed_date.isoformat())
print("Event start (local)     :", start_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
print("Event end (local)       :", end_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
print("Event start (UTC)       :", start_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"))
print("Event end (UTC)         :", end_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"))
print("Duration                : 1 hour")
print("Output file             :", OUTPUT_FILE)
print("UID                     :", uid)
print("ICS validation          : PASSED")
